learning_outcomes.text: Explains demand forecasting methods, applies them on an appropriate data set, and compares the results.
Performs inventory control using inventory management techniques (ABC, EOQ etc.) and interprets the outputs.
Performs capacity planning and evaluates layout design alternatives.
Creates Material Requirements Planning (MRP) and analyzes its effect on the production process.
Prepares a work order form suitable for the production process and manages it by following the workflow.
Prepares a work order form and a workflow plan with Gantt/Critical Path analyses.
Applies quality management methods and evaluates quality control results.
Defines the duties, authorities, and responsibilities of the production planning manager and team members.
Explains with examples that management is not possible without measurement and performance indicators.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Production Planning: basic concepts, role of planning in production systems and its importance in business management
Demand Forecasting Methods: basic methods, models and application examples
Capacity Planning and Layout Design: capacity utilization rate, types of layout designs
Inventory Management and Techniques: ABC and XYZ analysis, EOQ model
Use of ERP systems in production planning
Supply Chain Management: purchasing, finance and human resources process integration
Work Order Preparation and Order Tracking Processes
Work Time Measurement and Workflow Planning: Gantt chart, critical path analysis
Quality Management and Control: TQM, Six Sigma fundamentals
Technical Trip Report and Analysis: evaluation & outputs
Digital Transformation in Production Planning: global applications and new technologies
Final Evaluation, General Review and Reinforcement of Learning Outcomes
assessment_rules: The overall grade is calculated with a 40% contribution from Semester Learning Activities (Quiz 20%, Project Preparation 20%, Midterm Examination 60%) and a 60% contribution from End of Semester Learning Activities (Final Examination).
bibliography: Stevenson, W. J. (2020). Operations Management. Basic textbook covering production planning, demand forecasting, inventory management, quality and ERP topics. Available as an e-book in university libraries and many platforms.
Erel, E. (2022). Üretim planlama ve kontrol. İstanbul: Beta Yayınları.
